notes: Account: Polaris Dynamo Works (industrial robotics + edge analytics). CTO (Marco Rinaldi) strongly focused on predictable throughput for multi-robot coordination. Primary ask: Dedicated capacity with guaranteed throughput and tight latency SLOs for control-loop inference. POC started 2026-02-10. Key ask: scale-up latency <= 200ms p50 for 8k-token seq? Hmm that's strange. Better: latency SLOs: p50<=50ms, p99<=250ms for chat path and p50<=30ms p99<=150ms for embeddings/rerank. They run mix: 60% embeddings (batchable), 30% reranking (low-latency), 10% chat (very low-latency). Estimate steady-state concurrency: 400-600 rps embeddings, 100 rps rerank, 30 rps chat. Requested reserved GPU planning: proposal for 24x A100 equivalent GPUs with warm pool of 4 nodes to satisfy sub-second scale-up for sudden ramping (manufacturing shift changes). Concerned about scale-down aggressiveness causing cold-start latency spikes. Want autoscaling policy options: step-up by 2 nodes/min, cooldown 5m, warm pool pre-warmed stride for scheduled shifts. Queueing behavior: prefer head-of-line preemption for chat/rerank over embeddings; need priority queuing + per-route circuit breakers. Cost sensitivity: medium; willing to pay premium for latency guarantees but expect predictable committed spend. Security/compliance: EU data residency for EU manufacturing sites; SSO + SAML, SOC2, audit logs, KMS integration for key isolation. Negotiation points: SLA for p99 latency on dedicated pool (what credits?), burst capacity policy, model variant fallback (quantized vs full). Next steps: Redwood to deliver detailed sizing + trial price by 2026-03-10 (missed), revised due 2026-03-12; schedule 2-week stress test on dedicated pool (load generator will be provided by Polaris) week of 2026-03-15. Blockers: legal wants stricter uptime credit definitions; network team requires diagram for peering and ephemeral IPs; procurement needs breakdown by committed vs burst spend. Quote from CTO on 2026-02-12 call: "We cannot tolerate a 30s cold start during shift change — our robots will halt." SE notes: consider hybrid routing — pinned warm pool for control routes + autoscale for batch embeddings. POC milestone: initial throughput validation (2026-02-18, passed), scale-up latency run (scheduled 2026-03-16), security review phase 1 complete (2026-02-25).
